_rascunho: Draft translation of the Portuguese text (pt.json is the final one).
chamada: Abuse record, legal hotline and disappearance switch. Everything leaves this device encrypted: not even the people who run Alumia can open it.
limite: The key that opens what reaches you stays only on this device. If you lose the device or use Quick exit, what already arrived can no longer be opened: create another key for what comes next.

chave.texto: Anyone who is an organization's legal team, or someone's trusted contact, needs a key to receive. If you only send, you don't need one.
chave.semIdentidade: Turn on the new chat on this device first: the key is signed by your account's identity.
chave.nenhuma: You don't have a safety key yet.
chave.pronta: Your key is published and stored only on this device.
chave.outroAparelho: The published key is on another device. Creating a new one here means what arrives from now on opens only here.
chave.confirmarTrocar: Create another key? What already arrived for the old key only opens on the device that holds it.
chave.confirmarTirar: Remove your key? Nobody can encrypt for you until you create another.

plantao.texto: Sends an encrypted request only to the legal team the organization named. Only three things go: where, what happened and how to reach you. Alumia doesn't keep who sent it.
plantao.nenhuma: No verified organization has a legal hotline ready right now.
plantao.onde: Where you are or where it happened
plantao.contato: How the legal team reaches you
plantao.confirmar: Send the request to @{org}'s legal team? Only they can open it.
plantao.enviado: Request sent, encrypted, to the organization's legal team.

registro.texto: A photo or video taken now, with the file's digest (SHA-256) and, if the server has a public timestamp service configured, a timestamp that proves the time. It goes encrypted only to the organization's legal team. It is not published.
registro.arquivo: Take a photo or record a video
registro.local: Include where it was (encrypted; only if you want)
registro.contato: Include a contact (encrypted; only if you want)
registro.confirmar: Send the record to @{org}'s legal team? Only they can open it.
registro.semCarimbo: Record sent, encrypted. No timestamp: the service is not configured or didn't answer, so only the digest and this device's time go.

caixa.texto: What arrived encrypted for you as legal team. It doesn't say who sent it. It disappears in 30 days, or when you delete it.
caixa.confirmarApagar: Delete for you? When nobody else on the legal team has it, it is gone for good.
caixa.conferir: Checking the timestamp is up to you: it comes from the public service and is checked against its certificate (for example, openssl ts -verify).
caixa.confirmarSair: Leave @{org}'s legal team? You will stop receiving its requests.

gestao.texto: Name the legal team's accounts by @. The screen doesn't show who they are, not even to you after naming them: it only says whether the hotline is ready. Each person named must create a safety key.
gestao.naoPronta: @{org}'s hotline isn't ready yet: someone named still needs a key.

sumico.texto: If you don't log in to Alumia for a while, it can warn a trusted contact and/or delete your account. It stays off until you turn it on. Seven days before, you get a reminder; logging in again resets the deadline.
sumico.ligado: On: if you don't log in by {prazo}, {acao}.
sumico.dias: After how many days without logging in
sumico.destino: The contact's @ (your trusted contact in protest mode, with a safety key)
sumico.de: How you appear in the message
sumico.mensagem: The message (only that person reads it, after the deadline)
sumico.apagarAviso: Deleting the account can't be undone. What other people replied stays as "[post deleted]".
sumico.confirmarApagar: Turn the switch on with account deletion? If you don't log in by the deadline, the account is deleted for good.
sumico.confirmarDesligar: Turn the switch off? The stored message is deleted.

recebidos.texto: A trusted contact didn't log in for the time they chose. The message opens only on this device.
recebidos.naoAbre: This message doesn't open on this device.

erros.desligado: This part of Alumia isn't turned on yet.
erros.sem_identidade: Turn on the new chat on this device first.
erros.sem_chave_aqui: Your safety key isn't on this device.
erros.sem_assessoria: This organization's legal team doesn't have a key this device can check yet. Nothing was sent.
erros.sem_chave: That person hasn't created a safety key yet.
erros.nao_encontrado: Not found. Check the @ (for the switch, it must be your trusted contact in protest mode).
erros.nao_abre: It doesn't open on this device.
erros.grande_demais: The file is over 8 MB. Record a shorter video.
erros.sem_permissao: Only the organization's managers can do this.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment.
erros.entre_primeiro: Log in to your account first.
